options.name: init_config
options.description: All options defined here are available to all instances.

options.name: is_jmx
options.description: Whether or not this file is a configuration for a JMX integration.

options.name: collect_default_metrics
options.description: Whether or not the check should collect all default metrics.

options.name: new_gc_metrics
options.description:
Set to true to use better metric names for garbage collection metrics.
jvm.gc.cms.count   => jvm.gc.minor_collection_count
                      jvm.gc.major_collection_count
jvm.gc.parnew.time => jvm.gc.minor_collection_time
                      jvm.gc.major_collection_time
The default value is false to ensure backward compatibility.

options.name: service_check_prefix
options.description:
Custom service check prefix. e.g. `my_prefix` to get a service check called `my_prefix.can_connect`.
If not set, the default service check used is the integration name.

options.name: conf
options.description:
The list of metrics to be collected by the integration
Read http://docs.datadoghq.com/integrations/java/ to learn how to customize it
The default metrics to be collected are kept in metrics.yaml, but you can still
add your own metrics here.

options.name: service
options.description:
Attach the tag `service:<SERVICE>` to every metric, event, and service check emitted by this integration.

Additionally, this sets the default `service` for every log source.

options.name: instances
options.description: Every instance is scheduled independently of the others.

options.name: host
options.description: JMX hostname to connect to.

options.name: port
options.description: JMX port to connect to.

options.name: user
options.description: User to use when connecting to JMX.

options.name: password
options.description: Password to use when connecting to JMX.

options.name: process_name_regex
options.description:
Instead of using a host and port, the Agent can connect using the attach API.
This requires the JDK to be installed and the path to tools.jar to be set below.
Note: It needs to be set when process_name_regex parameter is set
e.g. .*process_name.*

Note: tools.jar was removed in Java 9: https://openjdk.java.net/jeps/220.
This option is supported in Java 8 and below.

options.name: tools_jar_path
options.description:
The tools.jar path to be used with the `process_name_regex` parameter,
for example: /usr/lib/jvm/java-7-openjdk-amd64/lib/tools.jar

Note: tools.jar was removed in Java 9: https://openjdk.java.net/jeps/220.
This option is supported in Java 8 and below.

options.name: name
options.description: Set the instance name to be used as the `instance` tag.

options.name: java_bin_path
options.description: `java_bin_path` should be set if the Agent cannot find your java executable.

options.name: java_options
options.description: A list of Java JVM options, for example: "-Xmx200m -Xms50m".

options.name: trust_store_path
options.description:
The path to your trusted store.
`trust_store_path` should be set if SSL is enabled.

options.name: trust_store_password
options.description:
The password for your TrustStore.jks file.
`trust_store_password` should be set if SSL is enabled.

options.name: key_store_path
options.description:
The path to your key store.
`key_store_path` should be set if client authentication is enabled on the target JVM.

options.name: key_store_password
options.description:
The password to your key store.
`key_store_password` should be set if client authentication is enabled on the target JVM.

options.name: rmi_registry_ssl
options.description: Whether or not the Agent should connect to the RMI registry using SSL.

options.name: rmi_connection_timeout
options.description: The connection timeout, in milliseconds, when connecting to a remote JVM.

options.name: rmi_client_timeout
options.description:
The timeout to consider a remote connection, already successfully established, as lost.
If a connected remote JVM does not reply after `rmi_client_timeout` milliseconds jmxfetch
will give up on that connection and retry.

options.name: collect_default_jvm_metrics
options.description: Configures the collection of default JVM metrics.

options.name: tags
options.description:
A list of tags to attach to every metric and service check emitted by this instance.

Learn more about tagging at https://docs.datadoghq.com/tagging

options.name: service
options.description:
Attach the tag `service:<SERVICE>` to every metric, event, and service check emitted by this integration.

Overrides any `service` defined in the `init_config` section.

options.name: min_collection_interval
options.description:
This changes the collection interval of the check. For more information, see:
https://docs.datadoghq.com/developers/write_agent_check/#collection-interval

options.name: empty_default_hostname
options.description:
This forces the check to send metrics with no hostname.

This is useful for cluster-level checks.
